name: stash
title: Stash
description: Organizer for a private collection of videos and pictures: it scans your folders, makes previews, and lets you tag, filter and play everything in the browser. Open it after deploying and follow the wizard (the library is /data, the other paths are filled in), then run the first scan. It has no sign-in until you set a user name and password under Settings > Security.

variables.name: PORT_STASH
variables.label: Host Port
variables.description: Port to expose Stash on; the Dozzle template uses 9999 too, change one when both run on one server

variables.name: STASH_MEDIA
variables.label: Media folder
variables.description: The folder on this server with your collection, mounted at /data
